name: Question 20
problem:
Jack, a basketball player, practices performing several sets of two free throws. The results are shown below. Based on this data, if the random $X$ represents the number of baskets he makes in a randomly selected set, what is $\text{SD}[X]?$

| Number of baskets | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frequency | $1$ | $8$ | $16$ |
